captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a road bike crankset consisting of a central bottom bracket spindle, a spider-style chainring, two crank arms, and two rectangular platform pedals. The spindle and chainring are colored matte black, while the hollowed-out crank arms and the main bodies of the pedals are light silver-grey. The assembly features multiple points of articulation: the entire crankset and chainring assembly rotates around the bottom bracket axis, and both pedals spin independently on their stub axles relative to the crank arms.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a road bike crankset with a spider chainring, two hollowed-out silver crank arms, and two rectangular platform pedals. Implement a revolute joint for the central bottom bracket rotation and separate revolute joints for each pedal's axle relative to its crank arm, using matte black for the spindle/chainring and silver-grey for the arms and pedals.
captions.factory: Construct the bottom bracket spindle using a cylinder primitive. Build the spider chainring by taking a thin cylinder/disc and using boolean subtraction with patterned boxes to cut out five spoke openings. Model the crank arms by extruding a rounded slot profile and pocketing it to make them hollow. Create the pedals as box shapes with hollow rectangular cutouts. Finally, assemble the parts using revolute joints: one continuous joint for the spindle to the frame origin, and two revolute joints connecting each pedal to its respective crank arm tip.
